purpose: Preserve the accepted multicore test while making its required UART evidence observable through PicoCalc USB CDC without human timing coordination.
unchanged_requirements: all four fixed v1 phases and values
final LCD layout and five PASS or FAIL results
Serial execution model with instruction quantum 1
core 1 remains parked and never returns

new_requirement.start: only after the initial final VERDICT marker and stable final screen
new_requirement.behavior: emit a complete evidence block containing the same five fixed v1 markers once per period forever
must_not: clear or redraw the final screen
wait for USB connection before running the test
require a key, command, reset timing, or monitor-open timing

required_evidence: complete UART log containing at least one complete five-marker evidence block
one final photograph showing all five PASS results
hardware_acceptance.human_actions: one UF2 write, start the serial monitor at any time after boot, save one final photograph and the captured log
hardware_acceptance.retry_policy: one retry only for an identified connection or capture error; repeated firmware FAIL is a false-accept candidate

out_of_scope: simultaneous LCD or PSRAM access from both cores
